project.description: Uses the dbgap telemetry to grab sample counts for all in consents in uploaded file then update the sample_count for that consent File format is csv study_id, version, consent code number

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/usr/bin/env bash set -euo pipefail
LOG_TS() { date +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z"; } log() { echo "[$(LOG_TS)] INFO $*" >&2; } warn() { echo "[$(LOG_TS)] WARN $*" >&2; } error() { echo "[$(LOG_TS)] ERROR $*" >&2; }
need() { command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { error "Missing required command: $1"; exit 2; }; }
need aws need jq need curl need csvgrep need csvcut need csvformat need in2csv
ROLE_ARN="${ROLE_ARN:-arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl}" ROLE_SESSION_NAME="${ROLE_SESSION_NAME:-s3-test}" ASSUME_DURATION_SECONDS="${ASSUME_DURATION_SECONDS:-3600}"
S3_BUCKET="${S3_BUCKET:-avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl}"
METADATA_URI="${METADATA_URI:-s3://${S3_BUCKET}/general/data/metadata_new_search.json}" MANAGED_INPUTS_URI="${MANAGED_INPUTS_URI:-s3://${S3_BUCKET}/general/resources/Managed_Inputs.csv}"
API_BASE="${API_BASE:-http://dictionaryetl:8086/api}" SSTR_BASE="${SSTR_BASE:-https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/gap/sstr/api/v1}"
CURL_CONNECT_TIMEOUT="${CURL_CONNECT_TIMEOUT:-15}" CURL_MAX_TIME="${CURL_MAX_TIME:-90}" CURL_RETRY_COUNT="${CURL_RETRY_COUNT:-8}" CURL_RETRY_DELAY="${CURL_RETRY_DELAY:-2}" CURL_RETRY_MAX_TIME="${CURL_RETRY_MAX_TIME:-180}"
cleanup() { rm -f "${assume_json:-}" 2>/dev/null || true unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN } trap cleanup EXIT
assume_role() { log "Assuming role ${ROLE_ARN}" assume_json="$(mktemp)" aws sts assume-role \ --duration-seconds "$ASSUME_DURATION_SECONDS" \ --role-arn "$ROLE_ARN" \ --role-session-name "$ROLE_SESSION_NAME" \ > "$assume_json"
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID="$(jq -r '.Credentials.AccessKeyId' "$assume_json")" AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY="$(jq -r '.Credentials.SecretAccessKey' "$assume_json")" AWS_SESSION_TOKEN="$(jq -r '.Credentials.SessionToken' "$assume_json")" rm -f "$assume_json" unset assume_json }
fetch_summary() { local stdy_id="$1" local version="$2" local resp_file="$3"
curl --fail --show-error --silent \ --connect-timeout "$CURL_CONNECT_TIMEOUT" \ --max-time "$CURL_MAX_TIME" \ --retry "$CURL_RETRY_COUNT" \ --retry-delay "$CURL_RETRY_DELAY" \ --retry-max-time "$CURL_RETRY_MAX_TIME" \ --retry-all-errors \ -H 'accept: application/json' \ "${SSTR_BASE}/study/${stdy_id}.${version}/summary" \ > "$resp_file" }
update_count_api() { local stdy_id="$1" local consent="$2" local count="$3"
curl --fail --show-error --silent \ --connect-timeout "$CURL_CONNECT_TIMEOUT" \ --max-time "$CURL_MAX_TIME" \ --retry "$CURL_RETRY_COUNT" \ --retry-delay "$CURL_RETRY_DELAY" \ --retry-max-time "$CURL_RETRY_MAX_TIME" \ --retry-all-errors \ --request PUT \ --data-urlencode "datasetRef=${stdy_id}" \ --data-urlencode "consentCode=c${consent}" \ --data-urlencode "sampleCount=${count}" \ "${API_BASE}/consent/counts" \ > /dev/null }
# ----------------------------- # Prep workspace # ----------------------------- mkdir -p data rm -f \ metadata.json \ Managed_Inputs.csv \ data/Managed_Inputs.csv \ updated_studies.csv \ study_list.csv \ genomic_counts.csv \ failed_genomic_counts.csv \ .study_hits.tmp
# ----------------------------- # Download inputs from S3 # ----------------------------- assume_role
log "Downloading metadata: ${METADATA_URI}" aws s3 cp "$METADATA_URI" metadata.json --no-progress
log "Downloading Managed_Inputs: ${MANAGED_INPUTS_URI}" aws s3 cp "$MANAGED_INPUTS_URI" Managed_Inputs.csv --no-progress aws s3 cp "$MANAGED_INPUTS_URI" data/Managed_Inputs.csv --no-progress
# ----------------------------- # Build updated studies list # ----------------------------- log "Computing updated studies list (ready=yes)" csvgrep -c "Data is ready to process" -m "Yes" data/Managed_Inputs.csv \ | csvcut -c "Study Identifier" \ | csvformat -E \ > updated_studies.csv
# ----------------------------- # Build study list from metadata # - data_type contains "G" # - study_identifier contains "phs" # - consent_group_code: strip leading "c" # ----------------------------- log "Extracting study/version/consent from metadata.json" jq '.bio_data_catalyst[] | select(.data_type | contains("G")) | select(.study_identifier | contains("phs")) | select(.consent_group_code != null) | { study_identifier: .study_identifier, study_version: .study_version, consent_group_code: (.consent_group_code | tostring | ltrimstr("c")) }' \ metadata.json \ | jq -s \ | in2csv -f json \ > study_list.csv
# ----------------------------- # Outputs # ----------------------------- log "Initializing output files" echo "study_identifier,consent_code,sample_count" > genomic_counts.csv echo "study_identifier,study_version,consent_code,reason" > failed_genomic_counts.csv
total_rows=0 eligible_rows=0 success_count=0 fetch_failures=0 api_failures=0 missing_count_failures=0 skipped_not_ready=0
tail -n +2 study_list.csv > .study_hits.tmp
while IFS=',' read -r stdy_id version consent; do total_rows=$((total_rows + 1))
stdy_id="${stdy_id//\"/}" version="${version//\"/}" consent="${consent//\"/}"
[[ -z "$stdy_id" || -z "$version" || -z "$consent" ]] && continue
if ! grep -Fxq "$stdy_id" updated_studies.csv; then skipped_not_ready=$((skipped_not_ready + 1)) continue fi
eligible_rows=$((eligible_rows + 1)) log "Updating counts for ${stdy_id}.${version} consent=c${consent}"
resp_file="${stdy_id}.c${consent}.response.json"
if ! fetch_summary "$stdy_id" "$version" "$resp_file"; then warn "Failed to fetch summary for ${stdy_id}.${version} consent=c${consent}; skipping" echo "${stdy_id},${version},c${consent},fetch_failed" >> failed_genomic_counts.csv fetch_failures=$((fetch_failures + 1)) continue fi
count="$( jq -r --argjson c "$consent" ' .study.consent_groups[] | select(.code == $c) | .sample_count ' "$resp_file" | head -n 1 )"
log "Resolved count for ${stdy_id}.${version} consent=c${consent}: ${count:-<empty>}"
if [[ -z "${count:-}" || "$count" == "null" ]]; then warn "No sample_count found for ${stdy_id}.${version} consent=c${consent}; skipping API update" echo "${stdy_id},${version},c${consent},sample_count_missing" >> failed_genomic_counts.csv missing_count_failures=$((missing_count_failures + 1)) continue fi
echo "${stdy_id},c${consent},${count}" >> genomic_counts.csv
if ! update_count_api "$stdy_id" "$consent" "$count"; then warn "Failed API update for ${stdy_id}.${version} consent=c${consent}; continuing" echo "${stdy_id},${version},c${consent},api_update_failed" >> failed_genomic_counts.csv api_failures=$((api_failures + 1)) continue fi
success_count=$((success_count + 1)) done < .study_hits.tmp
rm -f .study_hits.tmp
log "Done. Output: genomic_counts.csv" log "Summary:" log " total_rows=${total_rows}" log " eligible_rows=${eligible_rows}" log " success_count=${success_count}" log " fetch_failures=${fetch_failures}" log " api_failures=${api_failures}" log " missing_count_failures=${missing_count_failures}" log " skipped_not_ready=${skipped_not_ready}" log " failed_output=failed_genomic_counts.csv"
